name: serverless-function-logs
title: Serverless Function Logs
description: An edge serverless function invocation console reporting execution duration, memory consumption, and cold start metrics.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Technical
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Compact
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Monospace
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Serverless Execution Log Streaming: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
